s048F87.name: Overworld state 2: after level, save data
summary: Overworld state 2 ([$13D9] = 2, entry in PtrsLong04857D). Sets up the auto-walk from the level just cleared (CODE_049903).
If the tile under the player is one of 8 in DATA_048F7F (probably the ones that offer a save), copies the player data to the
save buffer at $1FA9 and mirrors the current player's position, tile and submap into the other player's slot.
Exit type [$0DD5] = $E0: waits for [$0DB1] to run out, then saves the level flags and sets [$13D9] = 4 (becomes 5).
Finally reads the tile number under the player into [$13C1] and advances [$13D9].
$049037: if [$13CA] is set, copies the 96 level flag bytes $1EA2 to $1F49, clears [$13CA] and sets [$1B87] = 5. Preserves X, Y, P.

s049058.name: Tables: direction steps and auto-walk fields
summary: $049058: tile step per direction. $049060: shift counts for the 2-bit direction field in $7E:D800 (one field per exit type 1-4).
$049064: direction index per field value. $04906C: level numbers at which auto-walk ends.

HardCodedOWPaths.name: Hardcoded overworld paths and state 3 entry
summary: Data ($049078-$04911F): paths for levels that leave the map without path tiles: level numbers, pipe position ($0178/$0128),
tile lists ($049086), direction lists ($0490CA) and offsets of each path in them ($04910E).
Code at $049120 is overworld state 3 ([$13D9] = 3): clears [$0DD8]; with auto-walk active goes straight to the walking code.
Otherwise reads Select and falls into OW_Player_Update (debug star-warp code after it is unreachable).

OW_Player_Update.name: Overworld: L+R on Destroyed Castle
summary: If L and R are both held and the player is on tile $81 (Destroyed Castle), enters the level; otherwise falls into OWPU_NoLR.

OWPU_NoLR.name: Overworld: check A/B/X/Y pressed
summary: If A, B, X or Y was newly pressed go to OWPU_ABXY, otherwise go to the walking code at $0491E9.

OWPU_ABXY.name: Overworld: button pressed on a tile
summary: Clears [$1B9E]. On a star tile ($5F) starts the star warp ([$13D9] = $0B, sound $0D). Otherwise tests for pipes and level tiles.

OWPU_NotOnStar.name: Overworld: check for pipe tiles
summary: Tile $82 (unused pipe 1) goes to OWPU_IsOnPipe, tile $5B (pipe 2) falls into it, anything else to OWPU_NotOnPipe.

OWPU_IsOnPipe.name: Overworld: enter pipe
summary: If exactly on the pipe spot (CODE_048509): [$1B9C]++, exit type [$0DD5] = 0 and game mode = $0B (fade to overworld, loads the other submap).

OWPU_NotOnPipe.name: Overworld: tiles that cannot be entered
summary: Tile >= $81: no level to enter, go walk ($0491E9). Lower tiles fall into OWPU_EnterLevel.

OWPU_EnterLevel.name: Overworld: enter level, then walk
summary: $04919F: starts a level. Sets the raise-hand animation, copies the current player's coins, lives, power-up, Yoshi color and
reserve item into the in-level RAM, requests the music fade ([$1DFB] = $80) and increments the game mode (fade to level).
$0491E9: walking code. Converts the player's X/Y to tile coordinates, computes the tile offset into [$04]. With auto-walk active,
ends on the levels in DATA_04906C ([$13D9] = 5) or takes the direction from the $7E:D800 field and jumps to $0492BC.

OWPU_NotAutoWalk.name: Overworld: start walking from a level tile
summary: Reads the d-pad. No direction: after [$144E] frames makes the player face down. Direction: allowed only if the level's flags
([$1EA2]) enable it (tile $82 always allows). Checks the neighboring tile: tiles $01-$86 are walked onto, otherwise tries the
hardcoded paths (DATA_049078). Sets target position [$0DC7], facing, [$144E] = $0F, advances [$13D9] (state 4) and exits to $049831.
Comments in the source describe this routine in detail (Nicol Bolas). Corner tiles (DATA_04A03C) use custom offsets instead of 8 pixels.

s049414.name: Data: overworld movement tables
summary: Tables used by the movement code after this chunk. Meaning only partly known: scale bytes, word offsets and the d-pad direction bits.

s049430.name: Data: tile/direction pairs and flags
summary: Table of (value, direction) pairs scanned from X = $1C down; a matching pair picks a flag from the table at $04944E.
